cards.observation_text: The lineage report places this animal outside the branch of underground sand swimmers.
cards.inference_text: Set aside the candidate from that burrowing branch; the other lineages remain possible.
cards.bonus_fact_text: Its closest living family group includes cattle, goats, sheep, and other bovids.
hints: The family tree bends away from a tiny underground specialist.

hints.text: The lineage report places it in the big northern mammal branch: hoofed animals, cats, bats, and scaly anteaters.
The lineage keeps its distance from the scale-covered anteater branch.

cards.observation_text: The adult weight estimate comes in below one metric tonne.
cards.inference_text: That leaves the lighter candidates in play and excludes the multi-tonne giant.
cards.bonus_fact_text: Broad, spreading hooves help it move across loose desert sand.
hints: The outline is large, but not towering.

hints.text: The body is not wrapped in overlapping scales.
Size estimate: a heavy animal, well over the weight of an adult person.

cards.observation_text: The defense record shows that this animal does not seal itself inside a ball of scales.
cards.inference_text: The candidate known for that armored curl can be crossed off.
cards.bonus_fact_text: Nomadic herds often travel during cooler hours and rest through intense daytime heat.
hints: When alarmed, the animal keeps its body open and mobile.

hints.text: It is usually recorded with others of its kind, not alone.
Field notes describe herds moving together across open ground.

cards.observation_text: The diet record shows this animal does not specialize in hunting large vertebrate prey.
cards.inference_text: Keep plant feeders and small-prey feeders in consideration.
cards.bonus_fact_text: Moisture from grasses, shrubs, and succulents can replace free drinking water.
hints: The meal site holds no sign of a heavy chase or kill.

hints.text: Its food comes from plants, not from other animals.
Feeding notes: a strict plant eater that grazes and browses.

cards.observation_text: The native range includes continental land.
cards.inference_text: The candidate confined to the Comoros island chain falls outside this range.
cards.bonus_fact_text: Wild and restored populations now occupy only a small part of the species' former Saharan range.
hints: The map signal belongs to a broad landmass, not a small island chain.

hints.text: Range notes rule out the South Asian mainland.
